## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and why it matters.

## Validation

- [ ] Added or updated deterministic behavior tests.
- [ ] Ran the relevant focused tests.
- [ ] Ran `pnpm check`.
- [ ] Verified dashboard changes at desktop and mobile widths, when applicable.

## Safety And Documentation

- [ ] No credentials, raw message content, or local configuration files are included.
- [ ] Safety, privacy, and provider limitations remain accurate.
- [ ] README or docs were updated when setup or behavior changed.
